name: alis-hub
description: ALIS Admin Control Panel — Playwright automation hub for settings, configuration, and standardization across ALIS communities.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
scripts.setup:env: copy .env.example server/.env && echo '✅ Created server/.env (configure your credentials)'
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:env && npm run setup:hooks
